episodes.title: The rumour that broke the fridge 🍋😱 #shorts
episodes.logline: The gossiping Lemon Twins spread a rumour that Brock is a frozen imposter, and when Avery demands the truth, Brock confesses he was born frozen.
episodes.description: The lemons have been squeezing secrets. Fridge Hearts, episode 16.

shots.keyframe: the Lemon Twins whispering to a crowd of vegetables in the crisper
shots.action: the vegetables gasp and pass the whisper along

lines.t: Did you hear? Brock isn't fresh!
Frozen! Bagged! An IMPOSTER!

shots.keyframe: Milo and Freddie hearing the rumour, mouths open
shots.action: they turn to look at Brock across the shelf

lines.t: Brock? Frozen?
That explains the frost in his eyes!

shots.keyframe: Kev shouting from the door shelf, Duchess rolling her eyes
shots.action: Kev waves his arms, Duchess sips from her cap

lines.t: A frozen veg dating a fresh avocado? SCANDAL!
Says the bottle that's mostly sugar.

shots.keyframe: Avery confronting Brock, the whole fridge watching in the background

lines.t: Everyone's saying you came from a bag. From the North.
Avery, I...

shots.keyframe: Rico stepping into the scene from the side

lines.t: Ask him why Queen Pea knew his name.
Rico. Stay out of this.

shots.keyframe: close on Brock, condensation like a tear on his stalk

lines.t: I wanted to tell you. I didn't want you to see me differently.

shots.keyframe: Avery gripping Brock's arms, eyes searching his

lines.t: Brock, look at me. Is it true?

shots.keyframe: Brock meeting her eyes, frost glinting in his own
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: Yes. I was born frozen. I was a bag in the North before I was anything.

episodes.title: Frozen or fresh... would you still love him? 🥦💚 #shorts
episodes.logline: Brock reveals his frozen past under Queen Pea, Avery accepts him spot and all, and Rico admits he started the rumour because he's been to the North too.
episodes.hook_text: He was never fresh. Does she care?
episodes.description: The truth about Brock. Fridge Hearts, episode 17.

lemon_lou.name: Lemon Lou
lemon_lou.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic bright yellow lemon woman, gossipy wide eyes, tiny green leaf on top like a bow, small cartoon arms, leaning conspiratorially

lemon_lu.name: Lemon Lu
lemon_lu.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic bright yellow lemon woman identical to her twin but with a leaf tilted the other way, gossipy wide eyes, small cartoon arms
lemon_lu.voice: fast, high, gossipy female, slightly lower

shots.keyframe: Brock and Avery sitting at the shelf edge, Brock telling his story
shots.action: Brock gazes upward toward the freezer

lines.t: Frozen on a farm. Shipped with a thousand brothers. Queen Pea raised us.

shots.keyframe: frosty flashback: a tiny young Brock in a bag of florets, Queen Pea towering over him

lines.t: You'll never be fresh, little floret.
One day I will be.

shots.keyframe: back in the present, Brock looking at his hands

lines.t: The Hand thawed me by mistake. I've been pretending ever since.

shots.keyframe: Avery taking Brock's hands in hers
shots.action: she touches her own mustard-covered spot

lines.t: I hide a brown spot under mustard. Who am I to judge?
You'd still... have me?

shots.keyframe: Avery pulling Brock into a hug
shots.action: sparkles of condensation drift around them

lines.t: Frozen or fresh. You're mine.

shots.keyframe: the Lemon Twins peeking from the crisper, stunned
shots.action: they look at each other, confused

lines.t: She FORGAVE him?
This isn't drama. It's... wholesome.

shots.keyframe: Duchess staring hard at Rico on the door shelf

lines.t: You started that rumour, didn't you?
I told two lemons one secret. Lemons do the rest.

shots.keyframe: Brock and Rico face to face on the main shelf
shots.action: Rico lowers his cap, eyes dark
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: How did you know about the North?
Because I've been there too. And I know what she wants.

episodes.title: Sunday Clean-Out: not everyone survives 😨 #shorts
episodes.logline: The dreaded Sunday Clean-Out sweeps the fridge, and for the first time ever the Hand reaches into the Dark Corner and takes Lenny.
episodes.hook_text: Every Sunday, the Hand clears the fridge.
episodes.description: Nobody is safe on a Sunday. Fridge Hearts, episode 18.

shots.keyframe: Milo running across the shelf screaming, Tilly confused
shots.action: Milo grabs Tilly and shakes her

lines.t: It's Sunday! The Clean-Out is coming!
The what?

shots.keyframe: Duchess and Rico bracing on the door shelf, jars lining up stiffly
shots.action: the jars straighten and polish themselves

lines.t: Every Sunday the Hand purges the weak. Hide your dates, darlings.
Pose like your life depends on it.

shots.keyframe: Avery hiding behind a jar, Brock standing in front of her
shots.action: Brock spreads his tiny arms protectively

lines.t: Stay behind me.
Brock, you're a broccoli, not a wall.

shots.keyframe: the door opens, the Hand sweeping old items into a bin bag, Milo posing desperately
shots.action: the Hand pauses over Milo, then moves on

lines.t: Look how fresh I am! Fresh! FRESH!

shots.keyframe: the Hand reaching deep into the Dark Corner for the first time, light hitting Lenny
shots.action: Lenny is pulled slowly into the light

lines.t: So... it's my turn.

shots.keyframe: Tilly clinging to Lenny as he is lifted
shots.action: Lenny gently pries her hand loose

lines.t: No! Not Lenny!
Little tofu. Remember. Some come back... different.

shots.keyframe: Lenny rising away into the blinding white light

lines.t: Goodbye, fridge.

shots.keyframe: the door shut, the Dark Corner empty, Tilly staring at the space
shots.action: a single light flickers in the corner and goes out
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: He's gone.
Nobody's ever been taken from the corner before.

shots.sfx: silence, light buzz cuts out, dramatic soap-opera orchestral sting

episodes.title: He came back... but he doesn't remember us 🫙 #shorts
episodes.logline: The fridge holds a funeral for Lenny, Tilly finds his final prophecy about a Feast, and then the Hand returns Lenny washed clean with no memory.
episodes.hook_text: They held a funeral. Then he came back.
episodes.description: Some come back different. Fridge Hearts, episode 19.

old_pickle.name: Old Pickle
old_pickle.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic very old wrinkled green pickle in a cloudy glass jar, long beard made of dill fronds, squinting wise eyes, small cartoon arms, hermit sage

shots.keyframe: a tiny birthday candle glowing in Lenny's empty spot, the cast gathered in mourning

lines.t: Lenny was mysterious. And smelly. And he was my friend.
Beautiful, Tilly.

shots.keyframe: Duchess and Brock standing side by side at the candle
shots.action: Brock wipes his eye with a floret

lines.t: The fridge feels younger without him.
Stay green, Lenny.

shots.keyframe: Milo and Freddie sitting at the shelf edge

lines.t: What happens to leftovers out there?
I've seen the bin, Milo.

shots.keyframe: Tilly discovering scratched drawings on the shelf wall where Lenny sat: a crown and a long table
shots.action: Tilly traces the drawings with her hand
shots.camera: close up on the scratches, then Tilly

lines.t: He left a message. A crown... and a giant table?

shots.keyframe: Old Pickle leaning out of his cloudy jar beside Tilly
shots.action: Old Pickle squints at the drawing

lines.t: That's no table, child. That's a Feast.
What's a Feast?

shots.keyframe: close on Old Pickle's face lit from below

lines.t: The day the Hand takes more than ever. And never says why.

shots.keyframe: the door opens, the Hand placing a sparkling clean, empty, see-through container in the Dark Corner

lines.t: Lenny?!

shots.keyframe: Lenny now crystal clear and empty, big innocent eyes on his lid, looking around brightly
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: Hello! Who are you all? Where am I?

episodes.title: He got refilled with CURRY 🍛🔥 #shorts
episodes.logline: Freshly washed Lenny is cheerful and memoryless until he's refilled with curry, starts a spice war with Rico, and briefly speaks a prophecy in his old voice.
episodes.hook_text: The mystery box got refilled... with CURRY 🔥
episodes.description: New Lenny, who dis? Fridge Hearts, episode 20.

shots.keyframe: transparent clean Lenny bouncing happily, Tilly staring
shots.action: Lenny spins to show he is see-through

lines.t: I'm so clean! I can see right through myself!
You don't remember anything?

shots.keyframe: Avery inspecting Lenny on the main shelf

lines.t: You used to be terrifying. Cryptic. Mysterious.
Me? I'm just a box! A happy box!

shots.keyframe: Brock crouching hopefully in front of Lenny
shots.action: Lenny makes a tiny spooky face, then laughs

lines.t: Say something spooky, bro. For old times.
Boo?

shots.keyframe: the Hand placing Lenny back, now filled with steaming orange curry
shots.action: Lenny's eyes flare orange and steam rises from his lid

lines.t: Ohhh. Ohhh, I feel... SPICY.

shots.keyframe: curry Lenny swaggering onto the door shelf next to Rico

lines.t: Make way. Hottest thing in the fridge coming through.
Excuse me? I AM the hottest thing.

shots.keyframe: Rico and Lenny face to face, both steaming and glowing red-orange
shots.action: steam pours off both, condensation fogs the shelf

lines.t: Feel this heat!
I've got cumin, coriander AND attitude!

shots.keyframe: Duchess fanning steam away, Tilly running between them
shots.action: Tilly holds her arms out to separate them

lines.t: Boys, you're fogging up the door.
Lenny, stop! This isn't you!

shots.keyframe: Lenny suddenly frozen, eyes going dark and hollow
shots.action: he speaks in his old voice, then blinks back to cheerful
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: The Feast... is coming.
Sorry, what was I saying?

episodes.title: The Freezer Queen invaded the fridge ❄️👑 #shorts
episodes.logline: Queen Pea is moved down from the freezer to defrost and immediately takes over the main shelf, vowing to claim the Door Shelf crown by Sunday.
episodes.description: Winter is here. Literally. Fridge Hearts, episode 21.

shots.keyframe: the Hand lowering a frosty Queen Pea from the freezer onto the main shelf, mist pouring off her
shots.action: frost spreads across the shelf where she lands

lines.t: At last. The warm lands.

shots.keyframe: Brock stepping protectively in front of the others

lines.t: Queen Pea.
Brock. You told them about me. Good. Fear saves time.

shots.keyframe: Queen Pea touching Milo's spout, frost spreading over it

lines.t: My spout! I can't feel my spout!
Kneel.

shots.keyframe: Avery stepping up to Queen Pea defiantly
shots.action: Queen Pea looks her up and down

lines.t: This is our shelf. You don't belong here.
Everything belongs to whoever's coldest.

shots.keyframe: Duchess and Kev watching the main shelf from above
shots.action: Kev points frantically, Duchess sips calmly

lines.t: She's taking over the main shelf!
Let her. Nobody conquers the door.

shots.keyframe: Queen Pea gazing up at the golden door shelf
shots.action: golden light reflects in her icy eyes
shots.camera: low angle past her toward the door

lines.t: That golden door. That's where my crown belongs.

shots.keyframe: Tilly approaching Queen Pea bravely

lines.t: Why do you want the crown?
I've been cold so long, little tofu. I want to be... looked at.

shots.keyframe: Queen Pea rising, frost climbing the fridge wall toward the door shelf
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: Tell the Duchess. By Sunday, the door is mine.

episodes.title: The Ice Queen started to melt 💧 #shorts
episodes.logline: As Queen Pea thaws she softens, shares a quiet truce with the Duchess, and Freddie bursts in with news of a list on the fridge door that says FEAST.

shots.keyframe: Queen Pea noticing droplets running down her frosted bag
shots.action: she touches a drop in horror

lines.t: What is this? Why am I... leaking?

shots.keyframe: Brock approaching Queen Pea, his tone gentle

lines.t: It's the thaw. It happened to me. You get softer.
I do NOT get softer.

shots.keyframe: Tilly offering Queen Pea a folded paper napkin

lines.t: Here. For your drips.
No one has ever... given me anything.

shots.keyframe: a weakened Queen Pea arriving at the golden door shelf, Duchess waiting

lines.t: Come to take my crown?
I came to sit down. My peas are tired.

shots.keyframe: Duchess pouring something into a bottle cap and offering it
shots.action: she gestures to the seat beside her

lines.t: Sit, then. Queen to queen.

shots.keyframe: the two queens side by side on the door shelf, golden light

lines.t: You're expired. I'm thawing. We're both running out of time.
Then let's not waste it fighting.

shots.keyframe: Freddie skidding onto the main shelf, out of breath

lines.t: Everyone! I saw the outside of the door! There's a list!
What kind of list?

shots.keyframe: Freddie trembling, everyone gathered around him
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: It says... FEAST.

episodes.title: The Feast is coming... who will be Chosen? 🍽️ #shorts
episodes.logline: The whole fridge reacts to news of the Feast with ambition and dread, and the Duchess shocks everyone by announcing she will step down afterward.
episodes.hook_text: The Feast is coming. Nobody is safe.
episodes.description: Panic on every shelf. Fridge Hearts, episode 23.

lemon_lou.name: Lemon Lou
lemon_lou.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic bright yellow lemon woman, gossipy wide eyes, tiny green leaf on top like a bow, small cartoon arms, leaning conspiratorially

lemon_lu.name: Lemon Lu
lemon_lu.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic bright yellow lemon woman identical to her twin but with a leaf tilted the other way, gossipy wide eyes, small cartoon arms
lemon_lu.voice: fast, high, gossipy female, slightly lower

shots.keyframe: Milo clutching Freddie in panic

lines.t: A Feast? What's a Feast?
It's when EVERYONE gets Chosen. All at once.

shots.keyframe: Avery glowing with excitement, Brock worried beside her
shots.action: Avery twirls, Brock catches her hand

lines.t: A Feast! Finally, an audience worthy of me!
Avery... what if they don't bring you back?

shots.keyframe: the Lemon Twins hugging each other in the crisper
shots.action: they strike a defiant pose together

lines.t: I heard lemons get squeezed at feasts!
Then we go out JUICY.

shots.keyframe: Kev and Rico puffing out their chests on the door shelf

lines.t: A Feast means ketchup! I'll be the star!
Please. A Feast needs heat.

shots.keyframe: curry-filled Lenny bouncing excitedly, Tilly beside him

lines.t: A party? I love parties!
Lenny, you're leftovers. You were AT the last party.

shots.keyframe: a softer, half-thawed Queen Pea sitting beside Tilly
shots.action: they both look at the closed fridge door

lines.t: In the North, they say the Feast takes the best of us.
Then what happens to the rest?

shots.keyframe: Duchess tapping a bottle cap with a toothpick for attention
shots.action: the whole fridge turns toward her

lines.t: Everyone. Gather. I have an announcement.

shots.keyframe: Duchess removing her gold lid-crown and holding it out
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: After the Feast, I step down. The door will need a new ruler.

shots.sfx: mass gasp, epic choir, dramatic soap-opera orchestral sting

episodes.loop_note: cliffhanger: who will rule the door?

episodes.title: The night before the Feast 🥑🌙 #shorts
episodes.logline: On Feast eve, a flawlessly ripe Avery chooses Brock over Rico's forty poems, accepts the Duchess's final favour, and faces the morning light.
episodes.hook_text: Tonight she's perfect. Tomorrow... the Feast.
episodes.description: Peak ripeness. Peak drama. Fridge Hearts, episode 24.

shots.keyframe: Avery glowing flawlessly in soft night light, no spots, radiant
shots.action: she admires her reflection in a spoon

lines.t: Not one spot. Tonight I am... peak ripeness.

shots.keyframe: Brock approaching Avery, stunned by her

lines.t: You look incredible.
Tomorrow I'll be Chosen. Isn't that what I always wanted?

shots.keyframe: Brock taking her hand

lines.t: And if they take you and not me?
Then you wait. Like I waited for you.

shots.keyframe: Rico finding Avery alone on the door shelf, holding a stack of napkin poems

lines.t: Before tomorrow, I have to say it. Forty poems, Avery. All for you.
Rico...

shots.keyframe: Avery gently pushing the poems back to Rico

lines.t: You're fire, Rico. But I need something green.
Then be happy. That's my forty-first poem.

shots.keyframe: Duchess appearing beside Avery in the golden light

lines.t: About that favour you owe me.
Now?
If you're Chosen, find out what happened to Lady Mayo.

shots.keyframe: Avery and Brock holding hands at the shelf edge, facing the closed door

lines.t: Whatever happens tomorrow...
We go out green.

shots.keyframe: morning, the door blasting open, blinding light, many Hands reaching in
shots.action: Avery stands tall as the light hits her
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: It's time.

shots.sfx: door whoosh, epic choir, dramatic soap-opera orchestral sting

episodes.title: The Feast took almost everyone 🍽️😱 #shorts
episodes.logline: On Feast day the Hand takes Kev, the Lemon Twins, Rico, Avery and Brock, leaving the rest of the fridge in eerie silence.
episodes.hook_text: Feast day. The Hand took them all.
episodes.description: The Feast has begun. Fridge Hearts, episode 25.

lemon_lou.name: Lemon Lou
lemon_lou.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic bright yellow lemon woman, gossipy wide eyes, tiny green leaf on top like a bow, small cartoon arms, leaning conspiratorially

lemon_lu.name: Lemon Lu
lemon_lu.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic bright yellow lemon woman identical to her twin but with a leaf tilted the other way, gossipy wide eyes, small cartoon arms
lemon_lu.voice: fast, high, gossipy female, slightly lower

shots.keyframe: blinding light, the Hand grabbing Kev from the door shelf
shots.action: Kev raises a fist as he is lifted away

lines.t: Ketchup for the PEOPLE!

shots.keyframe: the Hand scooping both Lemon Twins from the crisper
shots.action: the twins clutch each other mid-air

lines.t: Squeeze us gently!
Or don't!

shots.keyframe: the Hand lifting Avery high into the light, her glowing in glory
shots.action: Avery spreads her arms like a star on stage

lines.t: Look at me! I'm being CHOSEN!

shots.keyframe: the Hand grabbing Brock right after Avery

lines.t: Avery! I'm coming with you!

shots.keyframe: the Hand plucking Rico from the door shelf
shots.action: Rico tips his cap as he rises

lines.t: At last. Someone who appreciates heat.

shots.keyframe: the door slams shut, eerily empty shelves, Tilly and Milo alone in blue light
shots.action: they look around at the emptiness

lines.t: They took... everyone.
They didn't take me. Again.

shots.keyframe: Duchess and Queen Pea alone on the half-empty door shelf

lines.t: Do they come back?
Some do.

shots.keyframe: Tilly at the shelf edge staring at the closed door, faint laughter and plate clinks beyond it
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: Then we wait.

episodes.title: He came back... but she didn't 💔🥦 #shorts
episodes.logline: After the Feast, Rico returns a few drops lighter and Brock returns alone, revealing the Feast only needed the avocado.
episodes.hook_text: One by one, they came back. Except her.
episodes.description: The aftermath of the Feast. Fridge Hearts, episode 26.

shots.keyframe: Tilly and Milo still waiting at the shelf edge, hours later

lines.t: It's been hours.
Feasts are long. I read that. On my own carton.

shots.keyframe: Freddie and a thawed Queen Pea sitting together

lines.t: Do you think they're happy out there?
I think they're being useful. That's a kind of happy.

shots.keyframe: the door opens, the Hand placing a slightly emptier, dazed Rico back on the door shelf

lines.t: They only needed four drops.

shots.keyframe: Rico telling the Duchess what he saw

lines.t: I saw everything, Duchess. A table. Candles. Laughter.
And Avery? Brock?

shots.keyframe: Rico looking down, unable to meet her eyes

lines.t: I didn't see them come back.

shots.keyframe: the Hand placing Brock back, missing a few florets, alone
shots.action: Brock stands motionless as the door closes

lines.t: I'm back. Most of me.

shots.keyframe: Tilly rushing to Brock, looking past him for Avery
shots.action: Brock stares at his empty hands

lines.t: Brock! Where's Avery?

shots.keyframe: extreme close up on Brock's face, condensation running like tears
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: They only needed... the avocado.

shots.sfx: tragic piano, silence, dramatic soap-opera orchestral sting

episodes.title: She came back as GUACAMOLE 🥑😭 #shorts
episodes.logline: As the fridge mourns Avery and Rico reads her a poem, the Hand places a cling-filmed bowl beside Brock, and Avery speaks from inside it as guacamole.
episodes.hook_text: They mourned her. Then the Hand returned.
episodes.description: Some come back different. Fridge Hearts, episode 27.

shots.keyframe: Brock alone beside Avery's empty spot on the shelf

lines.t: She was ripe for one day. And it was today.

shots.keyframe: Tilly sitting beside Brock, leaning on his arm

lines.t: She said, 'We go out green.'
She went out green. I just... stayed.

shots.keyframe: Rico holding his stack of napkin poems, Duchess beside him

lines.t: Forty-one poems, and I never read her one.
Read it to the fridge, darling. We'll listen.

shots.keyframe: Rico standing at the edge of the door shelf reading from a napkin, the fridge listening below
shots.action: the light dims softly as he reads

lines.t: She was green as spring, and soft as dawn... and gone before the light came on.

shots.keyframe: Milo and Freddie wiping condensation tears
shots.action: Freddie puts his arm around Milo

lines.t: Nobody comes back from a Feast as themselves.
I came back as half of myself.

shots.keyframe: the door opens, the Hand placing a small glass bowl covered in cling film right beside Brock
shots.action: Brock turns to look at the bowl

lines.t: What's that?

shots.keyframe: Brock leaning over the bowl, under the cling film a smooth green surface with a lime slice, two familiar long-lashed hazel eyes opening
shots.action: the eyes blink up at Brock

lines.t: Those eyes...

shots.keyframe: Avery's face formed in the surface of the guacamole, a lime slice worn like a hair clip, the pit gone
shots.action: Avery smiles nervously up at Brock
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: Brock. Don't freak out. I'm... a dip now.

episodes.title: She lost everything... and found peace 🥑💚 #shorts
episodes.logline: Avery, now guacamole protected by lime, makes peace with her new form, reveals Lady Mayo became a legend, and the Duchess names Tilly as her successor.
episodes.hook_text: She was scared of browning. Not anymore.

shots.keyframe: Brock staring at Avery in her glass bowl

lines.t: You're... smooth.
I'm mashed, Brock. You can say it.

shots.keyframe: Tilly leaning over the bowl
shots.action: Avery tilts her lime slice proudly

lines.t: Are you sad?
I thought I would be. But look: lime. I'll never brown again.

shots.keyframe: close on Avery's peaceful face in the guacamole

lines.t: I spent my whole life scared of one spot. Now I'm ALL spots. And I'm fine.

shots.keyframe: Avery's bowl placed on the door shelf beside the Duchess

lines.t: I kept my promise. I asked about Lady Mayo out there.
And?

shots.keyframe: Avery smiling up at the Duchess

lines.t: She became the most famous sandwich in this house. They still talk about her.

shots.keyframe: Duchess touching the old pearl-ribbon lid beside her
shots.action: a single condensation tear rolls down her jar

lines.t: Then she didn't leave me. She just... became legendary.

shots.keyframe: Duchess straightening up regally

lines.t: Your debt is paid, darling. Now, one last decision.

shots.keyframe: Duchess addressing the whole fridge from the door shelf
shots.action: everyone turns; the camera finds a shocked Tilly far below
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: My successor on the Door Shelf will be... Tilly.

shots.sfx: mass gasp, epic choir, dramatic soap-opera orchestral sting

episodes.title: The tofu became QUEEN 👑 #shorts
episodes.logline: Tilly is crowned ruler of the Door Shelf despite a protest from a half-squeezed Kev, but in the middle of the celebration the fridge's power cuts out.
episodes.description: Long live the tofu. Fridge Hearts, episode 29.

shots.keyframe: a panicked Tilly beside Avery's bowl

lines.t: Me? A queen? I'm literally plain!
Plain absorbs everything. That's what a ruler needs.

shots.keyframe: coronation on the golden door shelf, Duchess placing a bottle-cap crown on Tilly
shots.action: the crown settles on Tilly's head

lines.t: Rule kindly. Store everyone. Forget no one.
Even the pickle?

shots.keyframe: a half-squeezed, crumpled Kev bursting onto the door shelf

lines.t: Objection! I survived the Feast! I demand a recount!
Kev, there was only one candidate.

shots.keyframe: a fully thawed, soft Queen Pea bowing to Tilly

lines.t: The North recognises Queen Tilly.
Just Tilly. And you're welcome on the door any time.

shots.keyframe: Rico and curry-filled Lenny cheering together

lines.t: Long live the tofu!
Long live... wait, who are we cheering?

shots.keyframe: Brock beside Avery's bowl, watching the coronation above

lines.t: Our little tofu.
Stay green, Your Majesty.

shots.keyframe: the fridge light suddenly cuts out, total darkness except glints in Tilly's eyes

lines.t: Um... is this part of the ceremony?

shots.keyframe: dozens of eyes glinting in the darkness
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: The hum. The HUM is gone!
Darlings... the power is out.

episodes.title: The blackout that saved the fridge 🌑❄️ #shorts
episodes.logline: During a power cut Queen Pea sacrifices the last of her cold to keep everyone fresh, the power returns, and a menacing new arrival is placed on the shelf.
episodes.hook_text: Power's out. Only one of them is still cold.

durian.name: Durian
durian.ref_prompt: anthropomorphic large spiky green-brown durian fruit, menacing grin, heavy-lidded villainous eyes, small cartoon arms, a faint visible stink cloud swirling around it

shots.keyframe: Milo and Freddie in the dark, eyes glinting, sweating condensation

lines.t: It's getting warm! I'm going to spoil in real time!
Stay calm! Panic makes you curdle!

shots.keyframe: Tilly in her bottle-cap crown standing tall in the dark

lines.t: Everyone, listen! We stay cold together.
How? Nothing in here is cold anymore!

shots.keyframe: a faint blue icy glow coming from Queen Pea in the darkness
shots.action: Queen Pea steps forward, frost still clinging to her centre
shots.camera: medium shot lit by her glow

lines.t: I am. There's still some North in me.
But you'll thaw completely.

shots.keyframe: close on Queen Pea's face in her own blue glow

lines.t: I spent years frozen and alone. Let me be cold for someone.

shots.keyframe: everyone huddling around Queen Pea like a campfire of cold blue light

lines.t: Group huddle! Everyone in!
Closer, darlings. Closer.

shots.keyframe: the light flickering back on, the hum returning, everyone cheering
shots.action: cool blue light floods back, groceries hug each other

lines.t: Queen Pea saved us.
We saved each other.

shots.keyframe: a completely thawed, soft, smiling Queen Pea
shots.action: Brock puts a napkin over her like a blanket

lines.t: So this is what warm feels like.
Welcome to the fridge, Your Majesty.

shots.keyframe: the door opens, the Hand placing a huge spiky durian on the shelf, everyone recoiling from its stink cloud
shots.action: the durian grins slowly at the camera
shots.camera: dramatic crash zoom into an extreme close-up, then hold on the face

lines.t: Hello, fridge. I'm going to be... a problem.
